scope: Failed atlas modification must not remain in model parameters, geometry data, generation, or subsequent saved edits
change: Restore previous data references, selection, generation and legend, then redraw the previous model when rendering or selection fails during modification
failure_injections: Renderer fails once after the modified state is installed
Selection fails once after the modified state is installed
Modification renderer and recovery redraw both fail persistently
Saved-edit reload and restoration of a scene handle both fail persistently
assertions: Previous centerline graph, modification mapping and surface mapping references restored
Saving after a recovered failure does not persist the failed modification
Incomplete recovery blocks modification, save and reload with a persistent recovery gate
Clearing the ordinary UI error does not remove that gate
Pre-existing saved file remains byte-identical after incomplete recovery
Edit status reports unavailable and instructs restarting the demo server
limitations: Synthetic fixtures and fake renderer; no browser or real WebGL failure injection
A failure of the recovery redraw is explicitly reported and is not a successful rollback
This does not complete the full M4 editing workflow
